selection_rule: Use the chronologically nearest prior independent Omiya FI first-day card before 2026-07-01 for which all race PRE fields required by frozen B1a are retrievable. Do not skip a valid nearer FI day because of its results.
hypothesis_from_first_day_to_test_not_fi: The 2026-07-01 500m day showed A-class top1 accuracy above S-class top1 accuracy and winner-in-top3 rate materially above top1 rate. Test whether direction repeats; do not alter weights or thresholds regardless of result.
